collection.name: Harry Potter
collection.author: J.K. Rowling
collection.description: Follow the magical journey of Harry Potter from his first day at Hogwarts to the final battle against the Dark Lord Voldemort. One of the best-selling series of all time.

collection.name: Hunger Games
collection.author: Suzanne Collins
collection.description: Set in a post-apocalyptic world, follow Katniss Everdeen as she becomes the symbol of a revolution against a ruthless totalitarian government.

collection.name: Maze Runner
collection.author: James Dashner
collection.description: Thomas wakes up with no memory in a mysterious maze. Together with other boys he must find a way out and uncover the shocking truth behind their imprisonment.

collection.name: Percy Jackson
collection.author: Rick Riordan
collection.description: Percy Jackson discovers he is the son of a Greek god and embarks on epic quests alongside other demigods to save both the mortal and Olympian worlds.

collection.name: Twilight
collection.author: Stephenie Meyer
collection.description: A timeless love story between a teenage girl and a vampire, set against the backdrop of a small rainy town in Washington and the world of supernatural creatures.

collection.name: Divergent
collection.author: Veronica Roth
collection.description: In a future Chicago divided into factions, Tris Prior discovers she is Divergent and must navigate a world on the brink of war while hiding her dangerous secret.

collection.name: Chronicles of Narnia
collection.author: C.S. Lewis
collection.description: A timeless classic series following children who discover the magical world of Narnia through a wardrobe and embark on extraordinary adventures guided by the great lion Aslan.

collection.name: Lord of the Rings
collection.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
collection.description: The greatest fantasy epic ever written. Follow Frodo Baggins and the Fellowship on their quest to destroy the One Ring and save Middle-earth from the Dark Lord Sauron.

collection.name: ACOTAR
collection.author: Sarah J. Maas
collection.description: A Court of Thorns and Roses is a breathtaking series of love, magic and war set in a stunning world of faeries filled with danger, passion and unforgettable characters.

collection.name: Dune
collection.author: Frank Herbert
collection.description: The greatest science fiction series ever written. Set on the desert planet Arrakis, Dune explores politics, religion and power in a richly imagined future universe.

collection.name: Diary of a Wimpy Kid
collection.author: Jeff Kinney
collection.description: The laugh-out-loud illustrated diary series following the hilariously relatable misadventures of middle schooler Greg Heffley as he navigates school, family and friendship.
